units.rawText: It is very difficult for humans to approach mutual understanding when they set out from different directions.

units.rawText: Different languages, different cultural backgrounds, different living environments... All of them draw lines between people, and very often, it is easy for the people standing on either side of these lines to view those opposite them with great malice.

units.rawText: This is a self-preservation instinct in living beings, thus it is not actually wrong. Therefore, I've never believed in forcing myself to understand others.

units.rawText: However, this is also the reason why those people who DO understand me are that much more precious... Do you get my meaning, Professor?
